1라운드부터 매 라운드 D3: D3 models each round from round 1.
2D6과 플레이어 수·총 영토 수의 관계는 확인이 필요하다. D66 영토: The relationship between 2D6, the number of players and the total number of territories needs verification. Distinguish the D66 territory type from the total territory count.
3라운드 이후 Check For Victory에서 운반자가 상대 배치 구: From round 3 onwards, at Check For Victory, the carrier touches the opposing deployment zone, or reaches the centre if that zone has no battlefield edge, then removes the marker.
3인치 내 모든 모델의 Ammo(X+)/RapidFire(X) 무기를 탄: Weapons with Ammo (X+) or Rapid Fire (X) carried by all models within 3 inches become Out of Ammo.
4회 명중이 hit 수인지 wound 수인지 확인하기 전에는 자동화하지: Do not automate this until it is verified whether four successful hits means hit results or wound results.
The AP sign and the direction that benefits the model need verification.
Agility 테스트 자연 1: A natural 1 on an Agility test.
Ammo-jack/DomeRunner/HiveWatcher/RogueDo: One free Ammo-Jack, Dome Runner, Hive Watcher, Rogue Doc or Slopper, including all options.
Beast/Brute/Pet/Support가아닌다른전투원: Another Fighter that is not a Beast, Brute, Pet or Support model.
Beast가 아닌 Active 아군 Fighter: An Active friendly Fighter that is not a Beast.
Blast 수류탄 사격 Hit roll 전: Before the hit roll for a Blast grenade attack.
Blaze (X+)의 X를 1 감소. 예: 5+ → 4+: Reduce the X in Blaze (X+) by 1, for example from 5+ to 4+.
Charge 선언 후 거리 굴림 전: After declaring Charge, before rolling distance.
Check For Victory에서 대상이 Out of Action 또는: At Check For Victory, the target is Out of Action or has left the battlefield for any reason.
Check For Victory에서 상대 모델 최소 절반이 Serious: At Check For Victory, at least half the opposing models are Seriously Injured/Damaged or Engaged.
Check For Victory에서 중앙 9\" 이내에 Seriously: At Check For Victory, a player wins if only their gang has a model that is not Seriously Injured/Damaged within 9 inches of the centre.
Coup de Grâce 주사위 굴림 전: Before rolling dice for Coup de Grâce.
Coup de Grâce의 Strength 대결 대신 Seriously: During Coup de Grâce, plant evidence on a Seriously Injured enemy Fighter instead of making the Strength roll-off.
D3을 D6/2 내림으로 계산하면 1에서 0이 생긴다. 일반 나눗셈 올림: Calculating D3 as D6/2 rounded down gives 0 on a roll of 1, conflicting with the general rule to round division up. Do not change the D3 implementation until this is verified.
D6=1사망;2-3은D66첫주사위5 고정+둘째D6 지속부상;4-6은Rec: D6: 1 means death; 2–3 means a Lasting Injury with the first D66 die fixed at 5 and a second D6 determining the units; 4–6 gives Recovery only.
Fight 해결 후 더 이상 Engaged가 아닐 때: After resolving Fight, when no longer Engaged.
Fighter 1\" 이내 Control Console 옆: A Fighter within 1 inch of a Control Console.
Firepower의 추가 Out of Ammo 처리에서 정확한 추가 굴림: The exact number of additional rolls for Firepower's additional Out of Ammo handling needs verification.
Ganger 서브타입 1명 모집 할인: Recruitment discount for one model with the Ganger subtype.
Injury dice 수량과 Lethality·실제 상실 Wound의 관: The relationship between the number of Injury dice, Lethality and actual Wounds lost needs verification.
Leader취득,역할에맞는명명Type/장비·스킬접근으로전환: Gain Leader and change to the appropriate named type, equipment access and skill access for that role.
Loner/Champion/Ganger/Prospect하위유형제거: Remove the Loner, Champion, Ganger and Prospect subtypes.
Loner아닌Champion: A Champion that is not a Loner.
Loner인Champion: A Champion that is a Loner.
Long Range에 Short Range까지 포함되는지 자동 해석하지: Do not automatically interpret Long Range as including Short Range.
M/S/T/A 각각+3,WS2+; 다음 라운드 종료단계 시작 또는 같은결: Gain +3 each to M, S, T and A, and WS 2+. Go Out of Action at the start of the next round's End phase or if this result occurs again.
Out of Action이 된 적 모델 1개당 갱이 10 크레딧 획득: The gang gains 10 credits for each enemy model taken Out of Action.
Rapid Fire 최대 Firepower dice 강제 및 Heat +: Must use the maximum Rapid Fire Firepower dice; gain D3 Heat.
Ready 제한의 정확한 적용 시점과 Blind 지속 시간은 확인이 필요: The exact timing of the Ready restriction and the duration of Blind need verification.
How base TP and additional TP are combined needs verification.
Do not interpret an improvement to WS, BS or Sv as adding 1 to the stored target number.
XP 0의 성장 처리는 확인이 필요하다. XP 0→1을 자동 성장으로 추: Advancement at 0 XP needs verification. Do not automatically add an advancement for increasing from 0 to 1 XP.
가장높은곳으로 run/retreat/crawl(각각비교전/교전/중상): Run, Retreat or Crawl to the highest point, respectively when unengaged, Engaged or Seriously Injured.
각 갱이 라운드당 한 번 Reload를 Free 행동으로 수행 가능: Each gang may perform one Reload as a Free action per round.
각 모델 TP 2와 Leader 2·Champion 1이 기본값에 추가되: Whether 2 TP per model and the Leader's 2 or Champion's 1 are added to or replace the base value needs verification.
각 지정 모서리 9\" 이내: Within 9 inches of each designated corner.
각 플레이어가 부업 1개 추가 생성: Each player generates one additional Side Job.
감소 후 Heat ≥6이면 종료; Heat가 0까지 내려갈 때까지 사격: Shuts down if Heat is at least 6 after reduction; cannot shoot until Heat falls to 0.
같은 대상에게 별도 공격 3회, 모두 자동 Scatter; 해결 후 Ou: Make three separate attacks against the same target; all Scatter automatically. Become Out of Ammo after resolving them.
갱이 Defender일 때: When the gang is the Defender.
거리 수치는 확인했으나 중앙선과 배치 영역의 정확한 관계는 배치 지도 확: Deployment distances are established, but the exact relationship between the centre line and deployment zones needs verification before drawing zones automatically.
거리용 D6 2개 중 1개 선택하여 Movement에 더함: Roll two D6, choose one and add it to Movement for the distance.
경량 원거리 무기 예외에 사용하는 WS 또는 BS는 확인이 필요하며 임의: Whether the Light ranged weapon exception uses WS or BS needs verification; do not change it arbitrarily.
공격 모델 추가 1 XP: The attacking model gains 1 additional XP.
공격자가 가장자리 중앙에서 전장 안 6\" 지점 Objective, 방어: The attacker places an objective 6 inches inwards from the midpoint of its battlefield edge; the defender places one at the corresponding position on the opposite edge.
굴리기전에50크레딧추가지출마다결과+1: Before rolling, each additional 50 credits spent gives +1 to the result.
굴림 없이 Bottle Check 자동 통과: Automatically pass the Bottle Check without rolling.
굴림보다 높은 결과와 낮은 결과 중 어느 것을 고를 수 있는지 확인이 필: Whether a result above or below the rolled result may be chosen needs verification. Do not assume either direction is allowed.
그 라운드 적 Out of Action 모델마다 1 VP: Gain 1 VP for each enemy model taken Out of Action that round.
그 활성화 Weapon Skill +1. 다음 활성화 시작까지 모든 적이: Gain a +1 Weapon Skill improvement for that activation. Until this Fighter's next activation starts, all enemies attacking this Fighter count as WS 2+.
그 활성화 동안 Coup de Grâce를 Free 행동으로 수행: Perform Coup de Grâce as a Free action during that activation.
그 활성화 동안 Reload를 Free 행동으로 수행: Perform Reload as a Free action during that activation.
그 활성화 동안 Shoot를 Free 행동으로 수행: Perform Shoot as a Free action during that activation.
그 활성화에 이미 Charge했어도 Free Charge; 일반 거리 대: Make a Free Charge even if already Charged this activation; move D6+2 inches instead of the normal distance.
그 활성화에 행동 1회 추가: Gain one additional action for that activation.
근접 공격으로 적 모델을 Seriously Injured/Damaged: Make an enemy model Seriously Injured/Damaged or take it Out of Action with a melee attack.
기존능력치·스킬·특수규칙유지: Keep existing characteristics, skills and special rules.
나머지 두 모서리 9\" 이내: Within 9 inches of the other two corners.
높은 숫자 선택과 5의 예시가 가리키는 2–5 결과가 일치하지 않아 확인: Choosing higher numbers conflicts with the 2–5 range associated with a roll of 5 and needs verification.
다른 전투원의 회복테스트 성공지원: Successfully assist another Fighter's Recovery Test.
다음승급XP: XP required for the next advancement.
대결 굴림 승자 선택; 상대는 반대 가장자리: The roll-off winner chooses; the opponent uses the opposite edge.
대결 굴림 승자가 모서리 선택; 그곳과 대각 반대 모서리가 자기 구역: The roll-off winner chooses a corner and uses that corner and the diagonally opposite corner.
대결 굴림 승자가 전장 구역 선택; 상대 반대 구역: The roll-off winner chooses a battlefield quarter; the opponent uses the opposite quarter.
대상 적 Fighter 자동 Out of Action; 주사위 불필요: The target enemy Fighter automatically goes Out of Action; no roll is required.
대상은다른포스트사이클행동불가: The target cannot perform another post-cycle action.
대상이Leader/Champion/Brute/Vehicle: The target is a Leader, Champion, Brute or Vehicle.
동일 파워 자유재발현 또는 방해 중이면 자기 파워 자유발현 시도; 추가역: Manifest the same power again for free, or, if disrupting, attempt to manifest one of the Wyrd's own powers for free. Further Perils may occur. After resolving it, end the activation, become Suppressed and suffer an S4/AP-4/L1 hit.
동일시퀀스에의료호송과바이오닉의동시대상불가: Cannot receive both Medical Escort and Bionics Installation in the same sequence.
명부업데이트시작: At the start of roster updates.
명중 여부와 관계없이 대상 Suppressed; Skill로 이를 방지할: The target becomes Suppressed whether or not it was hit; skills cannot prevent this.
Laying models down is an optional way to show their state; markers are the default.
모델(아군 포함)이 무기 사거리·시야 내에서 자기 활성화 종료: A model, including a friendly model, ends its own activation within the weapon's range and line of sight.
모든 갱의 모델 배치 후: After all gangs' models have deployed.
모든모델에서최대한멀리 run/retreat/crawl: Run, Retreat or Crawl as far as possible from all models.
무기의 Long Range 내이며 엄폐 상태가 아닌 모델: A model within the weapon's Long Range and not in cover.
The exact card pool and weighting algorithm for random selection need verification.
The distance and action cost for opening or closing doors need verification.
미지불/부족이면굴림없이대상사망: If unpaid or funds are insufficient, the patient dies without a roll.
방어자가 전장 중앙 6\" 이내 성소 마커 1개 배치: The defender places 1 shrine marker within 6" of the battlefield centre.
방어자부터 상대 배치 구역에 Objective 1개씩, 각자 3개. 각: Starting with the defender, each player places 3 Objectives in the opposing deployment zone, 1 at a time. All Objectives must be at least 6" apart.
보유 무기 중 Heavy/Blast 없는 1개가 활성화 종료까지 Ligh: Choose 1 carried weapon without Heavy or Blast; it gains Light until the end of the activation.
부업 달성 시 추가 D3 × 10 크레딧: Gain an additional D3 × 10 credits for completing the Side Hustle.
비교전은모든LOS밖으로run; 교전은직접멀리retreat; 중상은모든LO: If not Engaged, run out of all line of sight. If Engaged, retreat directly away. If Seriously Injured, crawl out of all line of sight and remain more than 1 inch from other models.
사망 장비 회수와 은퇴 장비 회수는 별도다. 유형별 소지품 소멸 규칙도: Recovering equipment after death and after retirement are separate procedures. Also check the equipment-loss rules for the relevant fighter type.
사전 측정 금지 도구 규칙을 채택하면 행동 선언 후 측정; 사거리 실패도: If using the no-pre-measuring rule, measure after declaring the action. An out-of-range attack is still spent; resolve side effects such as Unstable and Ammo.
산란방향 D6인치 이동, 추락 가능: Move D6 inches in the scatter direction; this can cause a fall.
상대 배치 구역 Objective 지배: Control an Objective in the opposing deployment zone.
상대 배치 구역; 상대 배치 구역이 없으면 중앙 6\" 이내: In the opposing deployment zone; if there is no opposing deployment zone, within 6" of the centre.
상태와 관계없이 즉시 Shoot 또는 Fight, 해결 후 제거: Immediately perform Shoot or Fight regardless of status, then remove the fighter after resolving it.
새역할에서불허장비도기존소지는유지,원래역할전용추가구매는불가: Keep existing equipment even if the new role does not allow it, but cannot buy additional equipment exclusive to the original role.
선택 Fighter가 전투 종료 시 전장에 남음: The chosen fighter remains on the battlefield at the end of the battle.
선택 구역 중 중앙에서 최소 9\" 거리: Within the chosen zone, at least 9" from the centre.
선택한지속부상마다지불·개별제거,동일부상중첩각각계산: Pay for and remove each chosen Lasting Injury separately. Stacked instances of the same injury are each charged separately.
선택한지속손상개별제거;동일손상중첩도개별비용: Remove each chosen Lasting Damage separately. Stacked instances of the same damage are each charged separately.
센터리 건을 제자리 회전: Rotate the Sentry Gun in place.
시작Rep+2,첫전투공격자/방어자선택가능: Start with +2 Reputation and choose to be attacker or defender in the first battle.
시작보관금+100,창설중사용가능: Start with +100 credits in the stash, which can be spent during gang creation.
아군 Fighter 1명 즉시 Shoot; Ready 유지: 1 friendly fighter immediately performs Shoot and keeps its Ready marker.
아군 Fighter Out of Action 후 제거 전: After a friendly fighter goes Out of Action, before removing it.
아군 Fighter 활성화 직후, 행동 전: Immediately after a friendly fighter activates, before taking actions.
아군 Fighter가 Console 1\" 이내이면 그 Console 갱: If a friendly fighter is within 1" of a Console, models from that Console's gang are excluded as targets. Enemies cannot change this without the code.
아군 원거리 공격 해결 직후: Immediately after resolving a friendly ranged attack.
아군을 Ready처럼 활성화. 끝나면 Suppressed 및 Str –,: Activate a friendly fighter as though Ready. Afterwards it becomes Suppressed and suffers an automatic-wounding hit at Str -, AP -, L1. This hit cannot be prevented and allows no Save.
양 크루 배치 후 상대 배치 모델 중 Leader 제외하고 1개 무작위: After both crews deploy, randomly select and publicly identify 1 deployed opposing model other than the Leader.
양 크루 배치 후 자기 배치 Fighter 1명에게 소포 마커: After both crews deploy, place a parcel marker on 1 of your deployed fighters.
양 크루 배치 후 자기 배치 Prospect 무작위 1명 공개; 시작 크: After both crews deploy, randomly select and publicly identify 1 of your deployed Prospects. If the starting crew has no Prospect, randomly select a Ganger instead.
양쪽 모두 최소 2 VP면 무승부: Draw if both sides have at least 2 VP.
어느 쪽도 10VP 이상을 얻지 못한 경우의 무승부 종료 시점은 확인이: The point at which a draw ends the battle when neither side has reached 10 VP needs verification. Do not use it to end battles automatically.
어려운 지형 비용 2배: Movement through difficult terrain costs 2 times normal.
어려운 지형 이동 불이익 없음: No movement penalty for difficult terrain.
어려운/위험 지형 통과 영향 무시, 그 안 종료 시 Dexterity: Ignore the effects of passing through difficult or dangerous terrain; make a Dexterity check if ending within it.
Access to external trading and TP generation. The method for calculating TP needs verification.
원인이 된 Out of Ammo 결과마다 추가 Heat +D3: Add +D3 Heat for each resulting Out of Ammo result.
이 본문만으로 inactive/captured 모델의 레이팅 예외 정책을: Rating exceptions for inactive or captured models remain unverified.
Automatically hit when shooting an enemy already targeted by another friendly fighter this round. Still make a hit roll to resolve weapon traits.
자기 Fighter 활성화 차례: When it is your turn to activate a fighter.
자기 두 구역에 시작 크루 최대한 균등 분할: Split the starting crew as evenly as possible between your two zones.
자기행동으로 적 직접OOA: Directly take an enemy Out of Action with the fighter's own action.
자기행동으로 적 직접중상: Directly cause an enemy to become Seriously Injured with the fighter's own action.
적 Fighter 1명을 지정한다. 전투 종료까지 그 대상을 향한 Wou: Choose 1 enemy fighter. Gain +1 to wound rolls against that target until the end of the battle. While that enemy remains on the battlefield, all of the user's actions must target that enemy, even if other enemies could also be selected.
적용 범위가 경로로부터 1인치인지 공격자로부터 1인치인지 확인이 필요하다: Whether the effect extends 1 inch from the path or 1 inch from the attacker needs verification.
전문분야 수에 7개와 8개의 불일치가 있다. 스킬 대응과 누락 전문분야를: The specialisation count is inconsistent at 7 versus 8. Do not automatically reconstruct skill associations or missing specialisations.
전장 제거 후에도 Stash에 남아 다음 전투 사용 가능: Remains in the stash after removal from the battlefield and can be used in the next battle.
전투 중 1회 이상 실행; 수행자 전장 이탈 후에도 달성 유지: Perform at least 1 time during the battle. Completion is retained even if the fighter leaves the battlefield.
전투 중 잃었던 Wound 1 회복: Recover 1 Wound lost during the battle.
전투 중 적 Fighter 최소 1명에게 증거를 심었으면 종료 시 달성;: Completed at the end of the battle if evidence was planted on at least 1 enemy fighter during the battle, even if that target has left the battlefield.
전투원별전투당1회;차량/펫통제불가: Limited to 1 use per fighter per battle; cannot control vehicles or pets.
Whether the Suppressed marker is removed at the start or end of activation needs verification.
종료단계에서목표통제: Control the objective in the End phase.
중심5인치 폭발:명중모델 S5/AP-2/L1 및 제압; 워드는OOA: Centred 5-inch Blast: models hit suffer S5, AP-2, L1 and become Suppressed; the Wyrd goes Out of Action.
중앙 1개 + 각 플레이어 1개. 대결 굴림 승자부터, 다른 Object: 1 central Objective plus 1 per player. Starting with the winner of a roll-off, place each at least 6" from other Objectives and the battlefield edge.
지원의 범위는 확인이 필요하다. 회복 지원 외의 모든 지원에 자동 일반화: The scope of assistance needs verification. Do not automatically extend Recovery assistance rules to every form of assistance.
지형·장애물에서최대한멀리 run/retreat/crawl; 중상은모델1인: Run, retreat or crawl as far as possible from terrain and obstacles. Seriously Injured fighters must remain more than 1 inch from other models.
The damage terminology for vehicle Escape results of 3-6 needs verification.
차량/행어스온만남으면해산: Disband if only vehicles or Hangers-on remain.
차량은지원제공/수혜불가: Vehicles cannot provide or receive assistance.
창설후기존갱재고용모델들에XP9분배,모델당최대3: After gang creation, distribute 9 XP among re-recruited models from the existing gang, to a maximum of 3 per model.
첫 라운드 첫 Priority 굴림 전: Before the first Priority roll in the first round.
첫 라운드에는 Blast (3\"/5\") 또는 Template 무기 사: Cannot use Blast (3"/5") or Template weapons during the first round.
첫 라운드에는 원거리 무기 사용 불가: Cannot use ranged weapons during the first round.
최근접 아군/적군으로 charge; 교전이면 교전상대무작위fight; 중: Charge the nearest friendly or enemy model. If Engaged, Fight a randomly selected model you are Engaged with. If Seriously Injured, crawl towards the nearest model, ending more than 1 inch away.
